title: AnalysisSnapshot
description: Output of /argus:clarify. Problem understanding at a point in time. Ported from webapp's AnalysisSnapshot type (src/stores/types.ts:681).

version.description: Monotonic counter within a session. 0 = initial analysis, 1+ = deepening rounds.

real_question.description: The reframed question after surfacing hidden framing. NOT the user's surface request.

hidden_assumptions.description: Assumptions the user is making without stating. Each phrased as a declarative sentence.

skeleton.description: Bullet-level skeleton of what the final answer would contain. 3-7 bullets.

execution_plan.description: Steps for team deployment. Produced when real_question is clear enough to decompose.

insight.description: Key insight that emerged from this round of analysis. Present on deepening rounds.

framing_confidence.description: Self-assessed confidence that the reframed question is correct. <70 triggers framing validation.

framing_locked.description: User confirmed the reframing. Subsequent rounds cannot re-challenge.

convergence_score.description: Aggregate of question stability + assumption reduction. >=75 means ready to mix.

decision_line.description: A single sign-off-worthy decision sentence (Phase 1 typed question output).

request_type.description: Step-0 gate (clarify Step 1.7): what the user is actually asking for, independent of stakes. open_decision = navigating an undecided question (the ONLY type that flows the full reframe→probe→team pipeline). validation = the user has already decided and wants a pressure-check, not a re-open. vent = emotional processing, not a decision request — do not fork. info = a plain question — just answer. Absent on legacy snapshots → treat as open_decision for back-compat. Default to open_decision whenever the classification is not confident: a false non-open ejects a real decision from the engine, which is the more harmful error.

readiness.description: Step-0 RESISTANCE axis (clarify Step 1.7), meaningful only when request_type==open_decision. resistance = the decision has been open a long time AND no new information has arrived AND the user reports repeated back-and-forth — the bottleneck is not analysis, so generating more forks would arm the avoidance. Surface the pattern (conditioned on those observables, never as a verdict about the person) and offer the smallest real-world test. Set ONLY on explicit textual signals ('been putting this off for months', 'keep going back and forth'); default ready. Absent → ready.

decision_density.description: Estimated cognitive weight the decision deserves. low = single-action, reversible, high confidence — emit MinimalScaffold and stop. medium = standard FinalScaffold via team. high = critical-stakes, two-stage with debate. Set by /argus:clarify in Step 2 alongside the snapshot. Routing in /argus:sail Step 6 reads this. Absent on legacy snapshots — treat as medium for back-compat.

decision_density_reasoning.description: One-sentence justification for the chosen density. e.g., 'Reversible UI label change with no downstream signals — minimal mode.' Surfaced to user when density downgrade occurs so they can override.

stakes_guess.description: Pre-classification stakes hint produced by /argus:clarify. /argus:team Step 2 confirms or refines. /argus:sail Step 6 uses this for routing offer. Vocabulary matches classification.yaml.stakes.

stakes_confidence.description: Confidence in stakes_guess. <75 means /argus:sail SHOULD AskUserQuestion before locking the routing path (per M-preserve-user-agency). 75+ proceeds without confirmation.

reversibility.description: Estimate of how cheaply the decision can be undone. Required signal for decision_density==low (must be 'reversible').
